## History

Lauretta Bradley attended tea at the manse alongside [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md). During the gathering hosted by Mrs. [Wace](../character/wace.md), the girls enjoyed a wonderful evening together where they learned that a female teacher named Miss Agnes [Thorne](../character/thorne.md) had been hired for the local school.
